definitions.explanation: A prefix or standalone word indicating a smaller version of something.

examples.japanese: ミニスカート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{流行|はや}っている→流行る：02400_hayaru⟧。
ミニサイズ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{弁当|べんとう}→弁当：01014_bentou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}った→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ミニコンサート⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{開|ひら}かれていた→開く：01979_hiraku⟧。
examples.english: A mini concert was being held in front of the station.

notes:
A loanword from English "mini" used as a prefix to indicate a smaller or shorter version of something. Very productive in forming compound words.

COMPOUNDS:
- ミニスカート — miniskirt (often shortened to ミニスカ)
- ミニサイズ — mini size
- ミニゲーム — mini game
- ミニコンサート — mini concert
- ミニバン — minivan
- ミニチュア — miniature

USAGE:
When used alone (as a noun), ミニ often refers to a miniskirt: ミニ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧ (to wear a mini). As a prefix, it attaches freely to both Japanese and loanwords to create new compounds.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- マキシ — maxi (for clothing length)
- ⟦{大型|おおがた}→大型：03016_oogata⟧ — large-sized
